title: EvidenceRecord
description: A quantitative predicted-vs-observed comparison for one test on one run: the model/hypothesis prediction (with uncertainty) against the measured value, the signed residual, and whether the observation sits within the predicted uncertainty. Stamped with its immutable source (run, model version, grader). `holdout: true` marks an out-of-sample condition the engine did not fit on. Derived; never authored; never scored as the measurement itself. Strict at the top level.

band.description: the acceptance/prediction band the value summarizes

residual.description: observed.value - predicted.value, or null when either is non-numeric

within_uncertainty.description: |residual| <= predicted.uncertainty, or null when uncertainty is unknown

conditions.description: the run/intervention conditions this record was taken under

source.description: the immutable provenance of the measurement
